title: B-3: partner 15%-vs-12% bulk overload (PartnerPricingService map-miss)
expected: A derived maintenance line whose line-level Fortra_Product_Type__c is null must resolve to its true maintenance product type (New/Renewal Maintenance) via the bulk product-type map, so PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType returns the maintenance margin (New Maintenance 12% / Renewal Maintenance 10%) and NOT the Software default (15%). The B-3 bulk-overload defect (map-miss silently falling to the 15% Software margin) must be closed in the live class and covered by passing tests.
actual: PASS - B-3 is resolved in the live FortraUAT class (PartnerPricingService 01pWC000001wAzPYAU, LastModified 2026-06-12 Nir Kailash, 335 ln). The defect is closed by two cooperating mechanisms: (1) loadProductTypesForLines (L108-138) bulk-loads the Product2.Fortra_Product_Type__c fallback for every line whose QLI-level type is blank, and the posthook calls ensureProductTypesLoaded (live PartnerNetPricePosthook L157-160) so the map is fully pre-populated before per-line resolution; (2) the 3-arg resolveProductType (L228-245) delegates a map MISS to the single-arg QLI->Product2 lookup (L241) rather than returning the prior 'Software' default. getMarginForProductType (L253-278) then maps 'New Maintenance'->New_Maintenance_Percent__c and 'Renewal Maintenance'->Renewal_Maintenance_Percent__c, so a maintenance line can no longer pick up Software_Percent__c. The B-3 precondition is real and widespread in live data: 61,312 maintenance QLIs (Product2 type New/Renewal Maintenance) carry a NULL line-level Fortra_Product_Type__c and 9 are mis-set to 'Software' - without the Product2 fallback all of these would have resolved to the 15% Software margin. Default partner models confirm the 15-vs-12 gap (AB Test Account: Software 15 / New Maintenance 12 / Renewal Maintenance 10). SOLO PartnerPricingServiceTest = 28/28 pass, PartnerPricingService 81% coverage; the test class (also Nir, 2026-06-12) now carries DEDICATED B-3 coverage: getMarginForProductType asserts Software=15 and New Maintenance=12 (L181/183), testResolveProductType_fallsBackToProduct2 (L407), testResolveProductType_bulkMapMissFallsBackToProduct2Lookup asserting 'Bulk map miss should delegate to the single-arg QLI/Product2 lookup' (L626/643), testEnsureProductTypesLoaded_populatesMapBeforeBulkResolve resolving 'New Maintenance' from a null line-level type (L506-562), and loadProductTypesForTransactionLines resolving OrderItem->QLI->Product2 (L494/502). The stale local test that asserted a 'Software' default WITHOUT lookup has been superseded by the corrected live fallback tests. Canary renewal-maint lines (q00781109) carry Fortra_Product_Type__c='Renewal Maintenance' on both QLI and Product2 and PartnerDiscountPercent=12 (a maintenance rate, not 15 Software), and the RN-COLA-MATH FINEST log line 881 independently logged 'Partner%=12.00 ... not 15% Software'.
evidence: Live PartnerPricingService 01pWC000001wAzPYAU (LastModified 2026-06-12T20:42:56Z Nir Kailash, 335 ln) - 3-arg resolveProductType L237-244 delegates map MISS to single-arg QLI/Product2 lookup (L241 return resolveProductType(contextProductType, quoteLineItemId)); loadProductTypesForLines L124-136 Product2 fallback; getMarginForProductType L262-266 maps New Maintenance / Renewal Maintenance to their own percents

Live PartnerNetPricePosthook 01pWC000002VmiLYAS L157-160 calls PartnerPricingService.ensureProductTypesLoaded(lineItemIds, loadProductTypesForTransactionLines(lineItemIds)) so the bulk map is pre-populated with the Product2 fallback before per-line resolveProductType (L399-403)

B-3 precondition prevalence (live SOQL GROUP BY): maintenance QLIs (Product2.Fortra_Product_Type__c IN New/Renewal Maintenance) with QLI-level Fortra_Product_Type__c = null -> 61,312; mis-set 'Software' -> 9; correctly 'New Maintenance' 68,282; 'Renewal Maintenance' 485,308 - the 61,321 null/Software lines are exactly the cohort the Product2 fallback rescues from the 15% default
